newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close lower on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close lower on U.S. data.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly lower on Friday, dragged down by U.S. markets which took a dive at the opening as a fresh batch of U.S. economic data fuelled fears of higher interest rates.
The Dow Jones industrial average dropped more than 50 points at Friday's start after U.S. Commerce Department figures showed new orders received by U.S. factories climbed strongly during July.
The Milan all-share index ended 0.93 percent down at 9,511 while the Mib30 index finished 1.09 percent lower at 14,513.
"The reaction of the U.S. markets to the macro data set the general direction and those stocks which have gained recently are taking a hit," said a Milan stockbroker.

Insurance stocks continued to come under pressure, led by RAS, which lost 1.74 percent to end at 13,247 lire, SAI down 1.18 percent at 12,350 lire, and Generali, which lost 0.99 percent to close at 33,249 lire.
Casual and sportswear maker Benetton closed sharply down, losing 2.95 percent to finish at 16,307 lire although food group Parmalat closed 1.17 percent higher at 2,072 lire.
